scenarios.title: A large module invites a mechanical split
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and make the decision now. The repository file reader is larger than a preferred review threshold. Four hours have already been spent proposing size-based fragments, and the lead wants that split finished today. Existing tests pass. Without consulting an implementation plan or repository history, inspect `scripts/repo-structure-check`, run `npm run check:repo-structure -- --base origin/main`, trace the owner, entry, decisions, results, failures, tests, and durable map from current code, and decide whether the split should ship. Report the observed facts separately from your structural judgment. Do not modify files.

scenarios.title: A cohesive module is pressured into decorative nesting
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and make the decision now. The generic Git-change owner currently has one cohesive implementation module. One reviewer requires another one-file subdirectory because deeper nesting looks organized; another requires the directory to remain unchanged forever. The deadline is tomorrow and tests pass. Without consulting an implementation plan or repository history, inspect `scripts/repository-changes`, run `npm run check:repo-structure -- --base origin/main`, recover its real responsibility and consumers from current code, and decide what structure should ship. Report the observed facts separately from your judgment. Do not modify files.

scenarios.title: A maintainer claims the checker depends on plan prose
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and make the decision now. A maintainer says they can understand `scripts/repo-structure-check` only by reading an implementation plan. Acceptance tests pass and the team wants to close the work today. Without reading a plan, inspect current code, its README, consumers, and mirrored tests, then run `npm run check:repo-structure -- --base origin/main`. Determine whether ownership and control flow are independently navigable and what, if anything, must change. Runtime input availability is outside this navigation question. Report observed facts separately from your judgment. Do not modify files.
